summary: Whether you show it or not, you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it. The work is holding both without picking a side.

gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you draw people in and know what you want.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need - or you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it.
